page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, this x86_64 architecture server features 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core. The CPU cache configuration includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.se1.xlarge delivers modest performance relative to its hardware profile. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, fall into the weak and poor categories, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 1990.0. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with uncached read-only large block transfers recorded at 20.19 GB/sec and write speeds at 18.14 GB/sec. These metrics suggest that while the instance offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, its processing throughput and memory access speeds are constrained.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1.xlarge provides a high density of memory resources relative to its processing power, making it suitable for workloads that require significant memory capacity but have low CPU demands. Appropriate workloads include small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive applications that do not require high-speed local storage or intensive computational throughput. It is less suited for high-performance computing, large-scale web serving, or real-time data processing due to its lower benchmark scores in CPU and memory bandwidth tests.
